purpose: Economic public-belief labels for fresh late-discard training roots; no optimizer or direct promotion.

model.selection: Fixed original update79 parent derivative; not a winner selected from the new comparison.

seed_scope: Independent per rootId and sample, never the actual game seed/deck. Every legal discard shares the same64 public scenarios.
encoding_checks: All old state/action prefixes and engine-legal candidate order must equal schema4.0. Reproduce the frozen parent proposal. Persist its logits for future retention targets, not as ground-truth value.
target: Store every per-sample win credit, all action means and best-action ties. Do not collapse labels to a single target or use realized game outcomes.
caps: Preserve null outcomes and flag invalid; any cap makes the label shard fail admission. Never score a cap as defeat or silently drop a row.
selection: Every verified collected root, retaining fixed whole-deal train/validation splits and source families. No success or disagreement filtering.

evidence.scope: First eligible discard only,2p versus economic opponents. Other counts/opponents and repeated-discard deployment still require full-game validation.
